column1: # Nouns that can be a whole sentence without an article (frag.bare-noun):
# thanks, wishes and greetings, reactions, and the heads of insults and
# endearments. The noun keeps its usual modifiers: Grazie per il vostro
# invito!, Tesoro mio!, Pezzo d'asino! Any other noun needs an article or
# another determiner to be a sentence on its own (Vivo in un appartamento is
# a clause, not "alive in an apartment").
# An adjective on the list makes the noun after it one too: Buon viaggio!,
# lemma, part of speech (noun or adj), where it comes from:
#   owner       the owner's list on kolov-it/syntango#25
#   tatoeba     a sentence of homograph-set.jsonl that is such an utterance
